title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. title: WebMethods Analyst
description:

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento e suporte de integrações utilizando webMethods e webMethods.io. Essa pessoa atuará no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de integrações críticas entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos, garantindo estabilidade, performance e continuidade operacional dos ambientes de integração.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando webMethods Designer, Flow Language, Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em ambientes on-premises e cloud.
  • Implementar melhorias e correções em integrações existentes, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com módulos B2B e Integration do webMethods.io para criação e manutenção de integrações.
  • Apoiar clientes e áreas internas na definição e entendimento de cenários de integração.
  • Monitorar integrações e atuar na resolução de incidentes e análises de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver scripts e ferramentas de apoio para automação e evolução dos processos da equipe.
  • Participar de projetos de manutenção, expansão e modernização da plataforma de integração.
  • Realizar documentação técnica e promover compartilhamento de conhecimento com o time.
  • Atuar em ambiente ágil, participando de cerimônias Scrum, PI Planning e acompanhamento de atividades junto à gestão e times técnicos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em webMethods utilizando Flow Language via Designer.
  • Experiência com webMethods.io, incluindo Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos e serviços de rede:
  • DNS
  • HTTPS/APIs
  • SSH
  • FTPS/SFTP
  • SMTP
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de CI/CD e gerenciamento de releases utilizando GitHub.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Linux para atividades de suporte e manutenção de servidores.
  • Experiência em suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Boa lógica de programação e capacidade analítica.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas técnicos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas prioridades.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com automação de processos e scripts de apoio.
  • Vivência com integrações B2B.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud e integrações híbridas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e atuação próxima a Scrum Master.
  • Experiência com apresentações técnicas e interface com clientes globais.


Competências comportamentais:

  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Proatividade e autonomia.
  • Facilidade para trabalho em equipe e colaboração em ambientes ágeis.
  • Organização e senso de prioridade para atuação em projetos críticos.
  • Interesse contínuo em aprendizado e evolução técnica.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Por se tratar de uma empresa de consultoria, a Avenue Code poderá compartilhar suas informações com seus clientes e com outras empresas do Grupo CompassUol, às quais os(as) consultores(as) da Avenue Code estejam alocados para a prestação de serviços.

title: WebMethods Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para WebMethods Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento e suporte de integrações utilizando webMethods e webMethods.io. Essa pessoa atuará no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de integrações críticas entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos, garantindo estabilidade, performance e continuidade operacional dos ambientes de integração.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando webMethods Designer, Flow Language, Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em ambientes on-premises e cloud.
  • Implementar melhorias e correções em integrações existentes, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com módulos B2B e Integration do webMethods.io para criação e manutenção de integrações.
  • Apoiar clientes e áreas internas na definição e entendimento de cenários de integração.
  • Monitorar integrações e atuar na resolução de incidentes e análises de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver scripts e ferramentas de apoio para automação e evolução dos processos da equipe.
  • Participar de projetos de manutenção, expansão e modernização da plataforma de integração.
  • Realizar documentação técnica e promover compartilhamento de conhecimento com o time.
  • Atuar em ambiente ágil, participando de cerimônias Scrum, PI Planning e acompanhamento de atividades junto à gestão e times técnicos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em webMethods utilizando Flow Language via Designer.
  • Experiência com webMethods.io, incluindo Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos e serviços de rede:
  • DNS
  • HTTPS/APIs
  • SSH
  • FTPS/SFTP
  • SMTP
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de CI/CD e gerenciamento de releases utilizando GitHub.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Linux para atividades de suporte e manutenção de servidores.
  • Experiência em suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Boa lógica de programação e capacidade analítica.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas técnicos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas prioridades.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com automação de processos e scripts de apoio.

title: Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Solutions Architect | Data & AI (Presales) em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

As a Solutions Architect specialized in Data & AI, you will be responsible for driving business growth, expanding our market share, and accelerating our strategic partnership with Google Cloud.


This is a highly strategic, technical-commercial role. You will act as the trusted advisor for our clients, identifying new business opportunities, understanding complex business challenges, and architecting customized Google Cloud Data & AI solutions. Your ultimate goal is to bridge the gap between technical excellence and business value, presenting high-impact pitches to C-level executives to close deals and maximize Google Cloud adoption.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Business Development & Pipeline Growth: Identify, qualify, and develop new business opportunities for Data and Generative AI solutions within our Google Cloud ecosystem.
  • Google Partnership Alignment: Work closely with Google Cloud’s internal sales and technical teams (Partner Managers, Account Executives, and CE/CEs) to co-sell, align strategies, and map target accounts.
  • Executive Pitching & Value Selling: Lead discovery sessions and deliver compelling technical-commercial pitches to C-Level executives (CDO, CIO, CTO, CMO), translating complex technical architectures into clear business outcomes, ROI, and strategic value.
  • Solution Architecture & Prototyping: Design high-level, customized data architectures and coordinate rapid Proof of Concepts (PoCs) on Google Cloud to validate value and accelerate the client’s buying decision.
  • Proposal & RFP Leadership: Own the technical-commercial strategy for complex proposals and RFPs, defining the scope, commercial engineering, and value proposition of the proposed Google Cloud solution.
  • Advanced English


Required Qualifications:

  • Proven BDM or Technical Pre-Sales Experience: Solid track record in Business Development, Technical Sales, or Solution Architecture within the IT/Cloud Consulting industry, specifically driving cloud revenue.
  • Google Cloud Ecosystem Expertise: Deep knowledge of Google Cloud's data portfolio (BigQuery, Cloud Composer, Dataproc, Pub/Sub, Dataflow).
  • AI & Generative AI Acumen: Solid understanding of Google Cloud’s AI capabilities (Vertex AI, Model Garden, Gemini API), and how to position them to solve real-world business problems.
  • C-Level Communication & Storytelling: Outstanding communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and influence decision-makers at the executive level.
  • Commercial Strategy: Ability to structure complex deals, build business cases focused on ROI, and understand consumption-based cloud business models.
  • Data Strategy Knowledge: Strong understanding of modern data paradigms, such as Data Lakes, Data Governance, Data Mesh, and how data readiness impacts AI success.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Google Cloud Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer, Cloud Architect, or Digital Leader certifications are a strong differentiator.
  • Partner Ecosystem Experience: Prior experience working within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem or directly at Google.
  • Technical Background: Previous hands-on experience as a Data Engineer, Data Architect, or Data Scientist is a plus, ensuring high technical credibility with clients' engineering teams.


Work Environment:

  • A fast-paced, high-growth environment focused on innovation and results.
  • High visibility, working directly with strategic clients and global tech leaders (Google).
  • Direct impact on the company’s revenue growth and strategic partnership status.


A Avenue Code reforça seu compromisso com a privacidade e com todos os princípios assegurados pelas legislações de proteção de dados mais rigorosas do mundo, como a GDPR, LGPD, CCPA e CPRA. Os dados dos(as) candidatos(as) compartilhados com a Avenue Code serão mantidos sob confidencialidade e não serão transmitidos a terceiros não envolvidos, nem utilizados para finalidades distintas do processo de candidatura às posições em aberto. Buscamos um Desenvolvedor(a) Python com experiência em desenvolvimento de soluções web e integração com serviços em nuvem. O profissional atuará em projetos desafiadores, com foco em construção e evolução de aplicações, processamento de dados e desenvolvimento de APIs e interfaces.


Responsabilidades

- Desenvolver e manter aplicações em Python com foco em qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.

- Criar e evoluir serviços de back-end utilizando Python e NET Core

- Desenvolver e consumir APIs REST.

- Atuar na modelagem, consulta e otimização de dados em SQL e PostgreSQL

- Participar da implementação de soluções em AWS, utilizando serviços como: Athena; Glue; Lambda; QuickSight

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção de interfaces web com React e jQuery

- Trabalhar com arquitetura web baseada em MVC

- Colaborar com times de produto, dados e infraestrutura para entrega de soluções ponta a ponta.

- Realizar análise de requisitos técnicos, correções, melhorias e manutenção evolutiva.


Requisitos técnicos

- Experiência sólida com Python

- Conhecimento em AWS, especialmente: Athena; Glue; Lambda; QuickSight

- Vivência com Banco de Dados: SQL; PostgreSQL;

- Experiência com Back-end em: Python e .NET Core

- Conhecimentos em Front-end em: React e jQuery

- Experiência com Arquitetura Web MVC

- Familiaridade com desenvolvimento de APIs e integração entre sistemas.

- Boa capacidade de análise, organização e resolução de problemas.


Diferenciais

- Experiência com ambientes de dados e pipelines ETL/ELT.

- Conhecimento em boas práticas de desenvolvimento, testes automatizados e versionamento de código.

- Experiência prévia com aplicações cloud-native.

- Vivência em times ágeis.


Perfil desejado

- Perfil colaborativo e proativo.

- Boa comunicação com times técnicos e áreas de negócio.

- Capacidade de atuar em diferentes camadas da aplicação.

- Interesse por aprendizado contínuo e melhoria de processos.


Modelo de contratação

- CLT

- Remoto

title: WebMethods Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para WebMethods Analyst em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Sobre a posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com experiência em desenvolvimento e suporte de integrações utilizando webMethods e webMethods.io. Essa pessoa atuará no desenvolvimento, sustentação e evolução de integrações críticas entre sistemas internos e parceiros externos, garantindo estabilidade, performance e continuidade operacional dos ambientes de integração.


Principais responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter integrações utilizando webMethods Designer, Flow Language, Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Atuar no suporte e troubleshooting de integrações em ambientes on-premises e cloud.
  • Implementar melhorias e correções em integrações existentes, garantindo estabilidade e performance.
  • Trabalhar com módulos B2B e Integration do webMethods.io para criação e manutenção de integrações.
  • Apoiar clientes e áreas internas na definição e entendimento de cenários de integração.
  • Monitorar integrações e atuar na resolução de incidentes e análises de causa raiz.
  • Desenvolver scripts e ferramentas de apoio para automação e evolução dos processos da equipe.
  • Participar de projetos de manutenção, expansão e modernização da plataforma de integração.
  • Realizar documentação técnica e promover compartilhamento de conhecimento com o time.
  • Atuar em ambiente ágil, participando de cerimônias Scrum, PI Planning e acompanhamento de atividades junto à gestão e times técnicos.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

  • Experiência sólida com desenvolvimento em webMethods utilizando Flow Language via Designer.
  • Experiência com webMethods.io, incluindo Flow Services e Workflows.
  • Conhecimento em protocolos e serviços de rede:
  • DNS
  • HTTPS/APIs
  • SSH
  • FTPS/SFTP
  • SMTP
  • Conhecimento em conceitos de CI/CD e gerenciamento de releases utilizando GitHub.
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Linux para atividades de suporte e manutenção de servidores.
  • Experiência em suporte e monitoramento de aplicações.
  • Boa lógica de programação e capacidade analítica.
  • Experiência em troubleshooting e resolução de problemas técnicos.
  • Inglês avançado/fluente para comunicação escrita e verbal.
  • Capacidade de atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e com múltiplas prioridades.


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência com automação de processos e scripts de apoio.
  • Vivência com integrações B2B.
  • Experiência em ambientes cloud e integrações híbridas.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis e atuação próxima a Scrum Master.
  • Experiência com apresentações técnicas e interface com clientes globais.


Competências comportamentais:

  • Perfil analítico e orientado à resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento interpessoal.
  • Proatividade e autonomia.
  • Facilidade para trabalho em equipe e colaboração em ambientes ágeis.
  • Organização e senso de prioridade para atuação em projetos críticos.
  • Interesse contínuo em aprendizado e evolução técnica.


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Engenheiro de Dados Pleno/Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro de Dados Pleno/Sênior em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!


Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:

Se você gosta de atuar na construção e evolução de plataformas modernas de dados, trabalhando com arquiteturas escaláveis e processamento de alta volumetria...

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados com forte experiência em cloud, pipelines distribuídos e ambientes analíticos modernos...

Se você domina PySpark, AWS, Databricks e soluções de Data Lake/Data Warehouse , essa oportunidade é para você.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Desenvolver, estruturar e otimizar pipelines ETL/ELT escaláveis utilizando PySpark, AWS Glue, Databricks e AWS EMR
  • Processar grandes volumes de dados com foco em performance, confiabilidade e escalabilidade
  • Implementar arquiteturas robustas para ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados
  • Estruturar e administrar ambientes de Data Lake em AWS S3
  • Desenvolver modelos analíticos e soluções de Data Warehouse em Amazon Redshift
  • Garantir qualidade, governança, integridade e segurança dos dados
  • Criar, monitorar e otimizar workflows e DAGs no Apache Airflow
  • Gerenciar dependências complexas e garantir estabilidade das rotinas de dados
  • Automatizar processos orientados a eventos e integrações em tempo real
  • Desenvolver soluções de processamento de dados em streaming
  • Implementar estratégias de Change Data Capture (CDC) e migração de dados utilizando AWS DMS
  • Integrar dados provenientes de bancos relacionais e não relacionais
  • Otimizar estruturas de armazenamento e particionamento de dados em Delta
  • Disponibilizar dados para consultas performáticas via AWS Athena
  • Realizar tuning de queries SQL, jobs Spark e monitoramento de performance da infraestrutura


Habilidades e Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida em Engenharia de Dados
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python
  • Conhecimento avançado em SQL
  • Experiência com PySpark
  • Vivência no desenvolvimento de pipelines ETL/ELT
  • Conhecimento em Clean Code e boas práticas de engenharia
  • Experiência com AWS S3, AWS Glue, AWS EMR, AWS Athena, AWS Lambda, AWS Kinesis e AWS DMS
  • Conhecimento em DynamoDB e Amazon Redshift
  • Experiência com Databricks e Apache Airflow
  • Vivência com Git e versionamento de código
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD aplicado a dados
  • Experiência com arquitetura Data Lake e Data Warehouse
  • Conhecimento em BigQuery
  • Experiência com modelagem, particionamento e otimização de custos e consultas em GCP
  • Forte capacidade analítica e resolução de problemas
  • Perfil colaborativo e boa comunicação interpessoal
  • Capacidade de traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas
  • Senso de dono, proatividade e autonomia
  • Facilidade de atuação em ambientes multidisciplinares

Diferencial

  • Experiência com arquiteturas orientadas a eventos
  • Vivência com ambientes analíticos de grande volume
  • Atuação integrada com times de BI, Analytics e Ciência de Dados


Formato de trabalho

  • Modelo 100% REMOTO.


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Fullstack Pleno (PHP / React / Go)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenvolvedor(a) de Software Fullstack Pleno (PHP / React / Go) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Na HugLabs, estamos construindo produtos de software movidos por IA para resolver problemas reais de empresas através de automação, agentes inteligentes, dados e sistemas escaláveis.

Buscamos um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Fullstack com mentalidade de builder — alguém que goste de construir produtos de ponta a ponta, resolver problemas complexos e trabalhar com autonomia.

Não procuramos alguém apenas para executar tickets. Procuramos pessoas que queiram ajudar a construir o Brasil por meio de pesquisa e engenharia de ponta.


O que você vai fazer:

Você trabalhará diretamente na construção e evolução dos produtos da HugLabs, incluindo:

  • Plataformas SaaS B2B
  • Sistemas baseados em IA e automação
  • APIs e integrações complexas
  • Interfaces modernas de alta performance
  • Sistemas escaláveis e resilientes
  • Arquitetura de software e melhoria contínua do stack

Você terá espaço para propor melhorias, desafiar decisões técnicas e participar ativamente da evolução dos produtos.


Stack principal

Backend

  • PHP (Laravel)
  • Go (Golang)
  • APIs REST
  • PostgreSQL / bancos relacionais
  • Redis
  • Filas e processamento assíncrono


Frontend

  • React
  • TypeScript / JavaScript
  • Next.js (diferencial)
  • Tailwind CSS


Infraestrutura (plus)

  • Docker
  • Kubernetes
  • AWS / Cloud
  • CI/CD
  • Observabilidade



O que buscamos

Você provavelmente vai se destacar se:

  • Gosta de construir software de verdade
  • Aprende rápido tecnologias novas
  • Tem senso de ownership
  • Consegue navegar bem entre frontend e backend
  • Entende trade-offs técnicos
  • Tem preocupação com performance, escalabilidade e qualidade
  • É pragmático(a): sabe equilibrar velocidade e excelência



Requisitos

  • Experiência com PHP (preferencialmente Laravel)
  • Experiência com React
  • Experiência com APIs e arquitetura de software
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais
  • Familiaridade com versionamento (Git)
  • Experiência colocando software em produção



Diferenciais Importantes

  • Experiência com Go (Golang)
  • Conhecimento em DevOps / infraestrutura cloud
  • Docker e Kubernetes
  • Experiência com CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em sistemas distribuídos

title: Senior Mobile Developer (React Native)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Mobile Developer (React Native) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About

Flatiron is a global remote software development company with engineers located around the world. We unite experts from diverse backgrounds and experiences in a collaborative culture to deliver exceptional products and services for our clients. As a forward-thinking software engineering company, we provide industry-leading solutions to complex problems in both the US and the UK. Operating in a fast-paced, agile environment, we specialize in software consulting for our clients. We offer a stimulating and rewarding environment for our team members. We value innovation, continuous learning, and professional growth, and we strive to create a workplace where everyone can thrive. Join us at Flatiron and be a part of a team that is shaping the future of software development.


Job Summary

This role is heavily focused on cross-platform mobile development using React Native, while also requiring solid understanding of native mobile development concepts for both iOS and Android environments.


The ideal candidate has strong experience working with mobile advertising ecosystems, video player integrations, and content-heavy applications at scale. Candidates with previous experience in media, publishing, streaming, or broadcast environments are highly preferred.


Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain scalable cross-platform mobile applications using React Native for iOS and Android.
  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, backend engineers, and QA teams in an Agile environment.
  • Integrate and maintain mobile advertising solutions such as Google Ad Manager (GAM), DoubleClick, or similar ad stack technologies.
  • Work with video playback technologies and SDKs including native players, Video.js, JW Player, or similar solutions.
  • Implement performant, responsive, and reliable mobile user experiences for content-heavy applications.
  • Debug and resolve issues across both React Native and native mobile layers when necessary.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions and mobile engineering best practices.
  • Optimize application performance, stability, and maintainability.
  • Participate in code reviews, sprint planning, and technical discussions.
  • Write clean, reusable, and well-documented code.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Advanced level of written and oral English proficiency.
  • 5+ years of professional experience developing mobile applications for iOS and Android using React Native.
  • Strong proficiency with JavaScript/TypeScript and the React ecosystem.
  • Experience working directly with native mobile code when needed: iOS: Swift and/or Objective-C,Android: Java and/or Kotlin
  • Experience integrating and maintaining mobile ad stack technologies such as: Google Ad Manager (GAM),DoubleClick, Mobile advertising SDKs
  • Experience working with mobile video technologies and SDKs such as: JW Player, Native video players, Video.js
  • Streaming/video playback integrations
  • Experience integrating REST APIs and third-party mobile SDKs.
  • Solid understanding of mobile performance optimization and debugging.
  • Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
  • Understanding of Agile development principles.


Benefits

- Yearly Office Allowance Budget

- Macbook Purchase Support

- Wellbeing Support


If you think that you are a good fit for the position, please apply through LinkedIn.

Only CVs that are in English will be accepted.


Flatiron Software Co has a zero tolerance to discrimination policy. In this regard, during the course of the evaluation of your job application and during all your employment relation, if any, all discriminatory factors such as race, sex, sexual orientation, social gender definitions/roles, colour, national or social background, ethnicity, religion, age, disablement, political opinion or any status that is protected under law shall be totally disregarded.

title: AI Benchmark Engineer (Data Analysis) - 75113
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Engineer (Data Analysis) - 75113 em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are seeking experienced Engineers — Data Analysis to design and develop high-quality multi-agent benchmark tasks that evaluate the analytical reasoning, coordination, and execution capabilities of advanced AI systems.

In this role, you will build realistic benchmark tasks that require AI agents to analyze large, messy, multi-source datasets, decompose work across specialist sub-agents, and arrive at specific, verifiable conclusions. These tasks may involve structured and semi-structured data such as CSVs, JSON files, logs, reports, survey results, vendor assessments, or financial and operational documents.


Your work will help measure how effectively AI systems perform complex analytical workflows involving cross-referencing, contradiction detection, anomaly identification, and statistical reasoning across multiple data sources.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Design and author multi-agent benchmark tasks centered on complex data analysis workflows
  • Create realistic synthetic datasets or curate real-world style datasets across domains such as finance, operations, security, or market analysis
  • Build tasks that require agents to perform cross-referencing, anomaly detection, contradiction identification, and statistical computation across multiple sources
  • Develop decomposition guides that split analytical work across specialist sub-agents such as financial, technical, security, or operations analysts
  • Write precise oracle logic or verification scripts that validate specific analytical conclusions rather than generic summaries
  • Create reproducible evaluation environments using Python and Docker
  • Review task performance signals to ensure strong separation between weaker and stronger agentic systems
  • Refine tasks to improve determinism, clarity, difficulty, and scoring quality


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in data analysis
  • Strong proficiency in SQL and Python for data analysis and scripting (pandas, NumPy, or similar)
  • Experience working with real-world, messy datasets (CSV, JSON, logs, reports)
  • Ability to design non-trivial analytical questions with clear, specific, and verifiable answers
  • Solid understanding of statistical concepts (averages, distributions, outliers, correlations)
  • Familiarity with AI coding benchmark environments (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench)
  • Comfortable working with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging containers)


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading foundation model companies
  • Collaborate on high-impact work at the frontier of LLM evaluation and reasoning
  • Remote, flexible opportunities with global teams

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js)
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Full Stack Engineer (Node.js/React.js) em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

We are looking for a full-time, remote Senior Full Stack Engineer with 5+ years of full stack development experience and a strong background in React.js and Node.js. You will join our clients engineering team and transform ideas and user feedback into positive experiences. You will work closely with other engineers and the user experience team iterating on designs and releasing them. Your responsibilities will include end-to-end feature development from web interfaces to backend APIs to the database. You will also communicate with the clients customers understanding their needs so you can build features with them that deliver on what you learn.

The client fosters collaboration and a close-knit working environment within its development team valuing inclusion and independent thought from its members. The client will support you as you onboard and grow within your new role, and they expect you to provide the same support to other team members. You will manage your own workload by participating in sprint planning, voicing concerns, advocating for desirable development outcomes, and proactively addressing issues. The right candidate will join a team built to produce great software!

Successful full stack engineers must have in-depth knowledge of web development concepts, a solid understanding of API and relational database design, excellent coding skills, familiarity with single page applications, and an eagerness to learn.

Our client makes trust building in business relationships effortless. With greater trust comes greater business growth. At their core, our client takes the drudgery out of compliance by automating critical compliance activities and bringing joy into a traditionally drab space. The clients software platform allows companies quickly and cost effectively to adopt formal security and privacy programs, measure the efficacy of those programs against compliance standards, and share program achievements with customers via AI to answer security questionnaires. As a result, compliance becomes habitual, simply to understand and implement, and continuously verifiable so businesses gain transparency into compliance status.


Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with User Experience and Product teams creating end-to-end, new feature designs
  • Build applications and APIs in JavaScript using React.js and Node.js
  • Develop and implement highly responsive UI components
  • Create data models using RDBMS principles, implementing them in PostgreSQL
  • Troubleshoot interfaces and debug applications
  • Monitor and improve end-to-end performance
  • Communicate with and support our customers, helping them find and build solutions to their problems


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication and interpersonal skills
  • 5+ years of full stack software development experience writing single-page applications that talk to API back-ends with a strong background with React.js, Node.js, JavaScript, CSS, and HTML
  • Well-developed understanding of front-end concepts and different frameworks
  • Strong back-end experience designing APIs and domain models
  • Experience working in an AWS (preferred), GCP, Azure, or other cloud environments
  • Experience designing RDBMSs to support real-world application usage
  • Excellent troubleshooting skills and experience with browser-based debugging and performance-testing software
  • A focus on customer value delivery
  • Proven delivery experience in a vibrant, dynamic startup environment
  • Great listening skills and a willingness to understand what customers and team members need to achieve success
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • A willingness to learn from others and admit when you've made a mistake


Desired Experience

  • University degree in computer sciences/engineering or related field


Additional Information

  • Typical week is 40-45 hours, Monday Friday
  • 15 days Paid Time Off (PTO), 1 floating day, 3 sick days, and your national holidays
  • Start: ASAP


Core Client Values

  • The clients values are threaded into the very fabric of their culture.
  • Trust : We strive to continuously earn the trust of our team, customers, investors, and all other stakeholders proving we are dependable.
  • Health : We are diligent caretakers of the health of the business, but never prioritize it over the mental and physical health of our team.

  • Diversity : We work hard to nurture a team that is diverse in identity, belief, background, thought, and experience. Our diversity makes us stronger.

It is why they are committed to bringing people onboard from diverse backgrounds, races, religions, national origins, gender identities, sexual orientations, gender identities, ages, disabilities, or veteran statuses.


About Velozient

We are a privately-held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

The Inbound team develops highly scalable solutions to determine item attribute values (such as color, material, and style) and verify merchandise authenticity. This role works closely with Tech Leads, Product, and Engineering partners to design and deliver scalable, data-driven solutions.   • Impact-focused mindset with a passion for delivering high-quality models.

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para AI Benchmark Software Engineer - 75243 em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies, accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM, and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Software Engineers to design and build high-quality multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world software engineering workflows.

In this role, you will create tasks grounded in real open-source code changes such as bug fixes, migrations, and refactors. These tasks are used to evaluate how effectively AI agents can understand large codebases, apply precise modifications, and produce correct, testable outputs.

You will work within a structured evaluation framework (Harbor), define clear task instructions, design verification logic, and decompose complex engineering problems across multiple specialized agents.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Build multi-agent benchmark tasks based on real-world open-source code changes (bug fixes, migrations, refactors)
  • Work with the Harbor evaluation framework to run and validate tasks inside Docker environments
  • Write clear, precise task instructions specifying file paths, function signatures, expected behavior, and constraints
  • Design and implement Python-based verification scripts to validate correctness of agent-generated code changes
  • Create decomposition strategies that split complex code changes across multiple independent sub-agents
  • Run, debug, and refine tasks within containerized environments to ensure reproducibility and determinism
  • Evaluate task performance signals and improve task quality, clarity, and difficulty


Requirements:

  • 5+ years of experience in Python and JavaScript development
  • Experience with AI coding benchmarks (e.g., SWE-bench, Terminal-Bench)
  • Strong experience reading and navigating large open-source codebases (e.g., Django, Flask, FastAPI, Node.js, or similar)
  • Familiarity with Git workflows , including pull requests, diffs, cherry-picking, and working with specific commits
  • Comfortable working with Docker (writing Dockerfiles, building images, debugging container issues)
  • Experience writing test scripts (pytest, unittest, or custom assertion-based testing)
  • Ability to write clear, precise, and unambiguous technical specifications


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading foundation model companies
  • Collaborate on high-impact work at the frontier of LLM evaluation and reasoning
  • Remote, flexible opportunities with global teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with a 4-hour overlap with PST.

  • Atuar na interlocução técnica com instituições públicas, representantes setoriais e demais stakeholders
  • Acompanhar e analisar leis, normativas e regulamentações relacionadas à contabilidade de carbono, certificações e mercado de carbono
  • Contribuir para o posicionamento técnico do Instituto sobre instrumentos como o Sistema Brasileiro de Comércio de Emissões (SBCE) e mecanismos internacionais, como CBAM e outros mecanismos de ajuste de carbono na fronteira.
  • Identificar oportunidades de geração de valor para a neoindustrialização brasileira por meio do aprimoramento de metodologias, instrumentos de mercado e sistemas de certificação
  • Garantir consistência técnica e metodológica em relatórios, notas técnicas, apresentações e posicionamentos institucionais
  • Representar o Instituto E+ em eventos, grupos de trabalho e projetos nacionais e internacionais na temática


REQUISITOS TÉCNICOS


Formação superior completa em Engenharia Agronômica, Agronomia, Engenharia Ambiental, Ciências Ambientais, Ciências Florestais ou áreas correlatas


Conhecimento sólido das seguintes metodologias e referenciais:

  • IPCC
  • ISO 14040 e ISO 14044 (Avaliação de Ciclo de Vida)
  • GHG Protocol
  • Metodologias setoriais como WorldSteel, IAI e Bonsucro


Conhecimento de mercado de carbono e instrumentos regulatórios e comerciais, tais como:

  • Sistema Brasileiro de Comércio de Emissões (SBCE)
  • CBAM (União Europeia)
  • EU ETS
  • EU RED
  • RenovaBio
  • Entendimento da regulação de carbono no mercado doméstico e internacional


Capacidade analítica e de síntese

Excelente redação técnica

Inglês avançado


DIFERENCIAIS


  • Experiência prévia com certificações ambientais, verificação e auditoria
  • Experiência em descarbonização industrial e bioeconomia
  • Experiência em interação institucional com governo e setor produtivo
  • Vivência em consultorias, think tanks, associações setoriais ou organismos internacionais
  • Capacidade de articular análise técnica detalhada com visão estratégica
  • Boa comunicação oral e segurança para representação institucional
  • Perfil colaborativo e flexível para atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente

We're working exclusively with a fast-scaling, internationally established B2B SaaS business to find a Senior Full-Stack Engineer who wants to do more than just ship code; someone who wants to help shape a platform.


The Platform

This isn't a greenfield start-up with no traction, nor a legacy enterprise stuck in technical debt. It's something rarer: a mature, mission-critical SaaS platform mid-way through a significant cloud-native rebuild, with real customers, real revenue, and a serious engineering team that knows what it's doing.


The platform powers high-value, high-volume transactional operations globally; think live, real-time environments where reliability isn't a nice-to-have, it's the product. £50m+ transacted in 2026 alone. Clients operate across multiple sectors and international markets.


The Role

You'll work closely with the Lead Software Engineer and product leadership to extend and evolve the next-generation platform across:

  • Full-stack development; .NET 10 / ASP.NET Core on the backend, Angular / TypeScript on the front
  • Real-time application development using SignalR
  • Cloud-native architecture on Azure (AKS, Service Bus, Container Apps, Key Vault, Monitor)
  • CI/CD pipelines, Docker, Kubernetes, and modern DevOps practices
  • Multi-tenant white-label SaaS architecture
  • Engineering standards, mentoring, and long-term technical direction


This is a hands-on senior role with genuine influence, not a ticket-taker. You'll be contributing to architecture decisions, not just implementing them.


What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of commercial software engineering experience
  • Strong .NET / ASP.NET Core and Angular / TypeScript skills
  • Experience building scalable APIs and distributed backend systems
  • Cloud-native development on Azure
  • Docker and containerised deployment; solid Kubernetes understanding
  • PostgreSQL or equivalent relational database experience
  • Someone who cares about operational reliability, clean code, and product outcomes, not just velocity
  • Bonus points for experience with real-time / event-driven systems, multi-tenant SaaS, high-availability environments, or AI-assisted workflows.


Why This Role

  • Fully remote, flexible working culture built on trust
  • Small, experienced, highly collaborative team, you'll work closely with founders and leadership
  • High ownership, high influence, your decisions will shape the platform
  • A genuinely interesting problem domain with technical complexity that rewards good engineering
  • Up to $R20k-$R23k pcm + 28 days holiday (inclusive of UK bank holidays)


If you're a senior engineer who wants to do the best work of your career on a platform that genuinely matters to its customers, we'd like to speak with you.

title: Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior ML engineer | Fully remote | B2B em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Machine Learning Engineer who enjoys turning messy web data into structured, reliable company intelligence.


This is not a research role, management track or career step for people who mainly want to move up. It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly.


About us

Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform.

We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer.

The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages.


Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product.

The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well.

This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously.


Role description

As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product.


Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection.

You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale.


The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript.

You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation.


Your work includes:

• Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection

• Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats

• Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production

• Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases

• Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value

• Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling

• Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time

• Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS

• Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows


This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them.


Requirements

You bring:

• At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience

• Strong Python skills

• Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3

• Real production experience with ML on AWS

• Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning

• Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data

• Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content

• A strong eye for correctness and data quality

• Business level English

• The ability to work independently in a small remote team

• A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap

• Flat structure with direct communication

• Production product with real users and real data problems

• Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence

• Compensation based on senior contractor level


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.
