description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Headshots Retoucher em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description:

About Us

Headshots.com is transforming how professional headshots are delivered. Trusted by enterprise clients such as Boeing, Netflix, and American Express, we produce studio-quality headshots from smartphone images—backed by world-class production and technology.

Our retouching team is critical to delivering consistent, natural, high-quality results at scale. We are hiring experienced headshot retouchers for ongoing work who can handle high volume while maintaining realism, accuracy, and professional polish.


Role Overview

This role focuses on high-quality retouching of professional headshots sourced from mobile phone photos. You will work within established production standards to deliver natural, realistic results—preserving skin texture, correcting lighting issues, and ensuring consistency across batches.

Following a brief unpaid test project, selected candidates will invited for an interview, with the opportunity for long-term, steady work.


Core Responsibilities

Image Retouching & Quality Control

  • Retouch professional headshots from phone photos with a natural, realistic finish
  • Correct skin tone, noise, mixed lighting, exposure issues, and soft focus
  • Reduce or remove glasses glare while preserving realism
  • Perform background swaps and composites that look seamless and believable
  • Maintain consistency and quality across large batches of images


Production & Workflow Discipline

  • Deliver work on time and meet daily/weekly volume expectations
  • Follow established retouching guidelines and quality standards
  • Apply feedback consistently and efficiently
  • Communicate clearly if issues arise that could affect timelines or quality


Core Skills Required

  • Natural skin retouching (texture preserved; no plastic or over-processed look)
  • Clean hair masking and edge work (no halos)
  • Realistic background compositing
  • Strong color correction and exposure balancing, especially in uneven or mixed light
  • Excellent time management and consistency at scale
  • Strong written English (spoken English for occasional Zoom calls is a plus)


Hardware & Software Requirements (Must-Have)

  • Graphics tablet (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, or similar)
  • Legitimate Adobe Photoshop subscription (no cracked software)
  • MacBook Pro Retina or equivalent high-quality PC laptop display
  • Monitor accurate in sRGB (DCI-P3 support is a plus)


Volume, Timing & Pay

  • $5 USD per image
  • Expected volume after trial period: 100+ images/month, with potential to scale higher
  • The $2,000/month reference rate is based on completing approximately 20 headshots per day across 20 working days


Application Requirements (Read Carefully)

Apply by completing the test project:


Hiring Process

  • Applicants are asked to complete a brief unpaid test project
  • Successful test submissions will be invited to interview
  • Ongoing, consistent work available for high-performing retouchers
  • Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates. All applications must be submitted through Indeed.
  • Job Types: Full-time, Contract


IMPORTANT

All candidates must apply via LinkedIn. Direct contact with Headshots.com regarding this position will not be considered and may result in disqualification from the process.

title: Contract Review Attorney
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Contract Review Attorney em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Headshots.com 

At Headshots.com, we're reimagining how professional headshots are created and delivered. Trusted by clients like Boeing, Capital One, and American Express, we transform smartphone selfies into polished, studio-quality portraits within three business days. As our enterprise client base expands across industries and geographies, including a growing footprint in regulated healthcare environments, we are building out our legal function to support that growth.


We're looking for a Contract Review Attorney, reporting to the Chief Operating Officer, who will own the day-to-day review and negotiation of commercial agreements, partner closely with our business teams, and help us scale a thoughtful, risk-calibrated approach to enterprise contracting.


About the Role 

This role combines hands-on contract review with a strategic understanding of how commercial terms translate into operational risk and opportunity. You will be the primary reviewer on incoming Master Services Agreements, Business Associate Agreements, Data Processing Addenda, Statements of Work, and vendor contracts. You will work directly with leadership to redline, negotiate, and finalize agreements that protect the company while preserving the speed and flexibility that allow us to serve enterprise clients well.


We are looking for someone who brings both technical legal expertise and strong commercial judgment, someone who can identify which provisions matter, where to push, and where to accept reasonable client positions in service of getting deals closed.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the review and redlining of MSAs, BAAs, DPAs, SOWs, NDAs, and vendor agreements. Identify risk, draft fallback positions, and negotiate directly with client legal teams when needed. Translate complex legal terms into clear, plain-language recommendations for the business.
  • Coordinate with the business on Standard Contractual Clauses, data transfer impact assessments, and DPA terms.
  • Negotiate indemnification, limitation of liability, insurance requirements, IP ownership, audit rights, termination, and assignment provisions in a way that is proportionate to our scope and revenue. 
  • Develop playbooks and fallback positions so the business can move quickly on standard issues. Maintain contract templates, position playbooks, and a clause library. 
  • Work directly with sales, operations, and leadership to support active deal cycles. Translate legal positions into commercial recommendations. Provide guidance during pre-contract discussions so issues are surfaced early.
  • Track the status of in-flight negotiations and ensure timely follow-up with client counterparties.


What You Bring

Experience & Qualifications

  • Law degree (JD or LLM) from an accredited institution
  • Six or more years of commercial contracts experience, with meaningful time spent in-house or supporting in-house teams.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience reviewing and negotiating agreements (US and European commercial clients a plus)
  • Working knowledge of GDPR and cross-border data transfer requirements.
  • Strong command of commercial provisions: indemnification, limitation of liability, IP ownership, insurance, confidentiality, data security, termination, and assignment.
  • Familiarity with SaaS, professional services, and vendor agreements. 
  • Excellent English skills, both written and spoken. 


Mindset & Strengths

  • Commercial pragmatism. You understand that legal review serves business outcomes, and you know when to push, when to compromise, and when to escalate.
  • Clear written communication. You can explain complex legal positions to non-lawyers in plain language and translate client redlines into clear recommendations.
  • Calm and thorough under deadline pressure. You can manage multiple active negotiations without losing track of detail.
  • Independent operator. You can run a contract review process end-to-end with limited supervision and know when to surface issues to leadership.
  • Discretion and trustworthiness. You handle confidential business information with care.
  • A no-ego collaborator. You build trust through transparent communication, take ownership of your work, and welcome feedback.


Why Join Us 

Fully remote, flexible schedule with ET overlap. Work directly with founders and executive leadership on agreements that shape the company's growth. Opportunity to build out the legal function and contracting infrastructure at a fast-moving company. Exposure to a diverse, enterprise client base across industries and geographies.


IMPORTANT

Direct inquiries will disqualify candidates.


Compensation: $40-60/hour depending on experience

DESENVOLVEDOR BACK-END JAVA SENIOR (COM INGLÊS AVANÇADO)

Sobre o desafio

Fará parte de um time de tecnologia altamente colaborativo, atuando em projetos estratégicos que envolvem soluções digitais, integrações complexas e construção de plataformas escaláveis na nuvem.

O foco principal será o desenvolvimento de aplicações backend robustas, seguras e performáticas, utilizando boas práticas de arquitetura e engenharia de software, com forte atuação em cloud (GCP) e ambientes distribuídos.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações backend em Java, garantindo qualidade, performance e escalabilidade.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs RESTful, assegurando boas práticas de versionamento, documentação e segurança.
  • Aplicar princípios de arquitetura moderna, com foco em Arquitetura Hexagonal e desacoplamento entre camadas.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com arquitetos, POs e demais desenvolvedores na definição de soluções técnicas aderentes ao negócio.
  • Implementar testes automatizados (unitários e integrados), garantindo alta cobertura e confiabilidade do código.
  • Atuar na evolução contínua dos pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab, garantindo entregas frequentes e seguras.
  • Participar de decisões técnicas e revisões de código, contribuindo para a melhoria contínua do time.
  • Garantir a observabilidade e estabilidade das aplicações em ambiente cloud (GCP).


Requisitos técnicos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com desenvolvimento backend em Java.
  • Domínio do ecossistema Spring: Spring Boot, Spring Data, Spring Security e Spring Cloud.
  • Experiência com Hibernate e ferramentas de build como Maven.
  • Conhecimento sólido em testes com JUnit e Mockito.
  • Experiência com versionamento de banco de dados utilizando Flyway.
  • Familiaridade com Lombok e geração de relatórios com JasperReports.
  • Experiência na construção e documentação de APIs REST com Swagger/OpenAPI.
  • Vivência com Arquitetura Hexagonal (Ports & Adapters).
  • Experiência com pipelines de CI/CD utilizando GitLab.
  • Experiência com Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Experiência com microsserviços e arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Conhecimento em mensageria (Kafka, Pub/Sub ou similares).

  • Formação Acadêmica completo em cursos correlatos a TI


Diferenciais

  • Experiência com observabilidade (monitoramento, logs e tracing).
  • Vivência em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).
  • Experiência no setor automotivo ou em empresas de grande porte.


Perfil esperado

  • Forte senso de responsabilidade sobre qualidade e entrega.
  • Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica para resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Boa comunicação e colaboração com times multidisciplinares.
  • Proatividade na identificação de melhorias técnicas e evolução da arquitetura.
  • Interesse contínuo por aprendizado, inovação e boas práticas de engenharia.

title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lead Product Designer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who are we?

Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life.


Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing.


About the role

This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs.


You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here.



Key responsibilities

  • Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way.
  • Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations.
  • Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome.
  • Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit.
  • Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you.
  • Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong.


Must haves

  • 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly.
  • Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs.

title: K-POP Influencers
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para K-POP Influencers em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. K-POP & K-DRAMA Influencer Growth CreatorPowered by IZISURFAbout IZISURF

IZISURF is building a next-generation creator growth ecosystem focused on K-POP, K-Drama, Korean entertainment, and global fan communities. Our mission is to help passionate creators transform their content into scalable global media brands through audience growth, AI-powered optimization, fan engagement strategies, and cross-platform expansion.

We believe that the future of entertainment media belongs to creators who deeply understand fandom culture, digital storytelling, and internet trends. As Korean entertainment continues to influence global culture, we are creating an infrastructure that helps influencers grow faster, engage audiences more effectively, and unlock meaningful monetization opportunities.

Unlike traditional influencer agencies, IZISURF operates as a creator growth partner. We actively work alongside creators to optimize content performance, identify viral opportunities, improve audience retention, and expand creator reach across multiple social media platforms. Our goal is not only to help creators gain followers, but to help them build long-term digital brands with sustainable growth.

Position Overview

We are looking for highly creative, trend-aware, and passionate K-POP & K-Drama Influencer Growth Creators who are excited about Korean entertainment culture and want to build a strong global online presence.

This role is ideal for individuals who genuinely enjoy discussing K-POP groups, idols, dramas, entertainment news, fan theories, comeback analysis, performances, concerts, and online fandom culture. Whether you are already an influencer or an emerging creator with strong potential, we are interested in working with people who can create authentic and engaging content that resonates with audiences worldwide.

As part of IZISURF, creators will receive strategic support designed to accelerate growth. Our team helps creators improve audience engagement, optimize content formats, analyze performance metrics, and identify viral content opportunities. We work collaboratively with creators to develop sustainable content strategies rather than focusing only on short-term trends.

Responsibilities

The selected creator will regularly produce engaging content related to K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, entertainment culture, idol trends, music releases, and fan discussions. Content may include reactions, commentary, reviews, rankings, livestream discussions, entertainment analysis, short-form videos, and community engagement activities.

Creators will publish content across platforms such as TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, YouTube, X (Twitter), Threads, and other emerging media channels. The role requires staying highly informed about ongoing entertainment trends, comeback schedules, drama releases, viral online discussions, and fandom activities.

In addition to content production, creators will collaborate closely with the IZISURF growth team to improve visibility and engagement. This includes reviewing analytics, refining content strategy, experimenting with new content formats, and participating in cross-platform growth campaigns. We encourage creators to continuously evolve their personal brand while maintaining authenticity and strong audience connection.

Creators may also participate in brand collaborations, entertainment campaigns, livestream events, fan engagement projects, and promotional activities related to Korean entertainment and digital culture.

What Makes This Opportunity Different

At IZISURF, we do not simply recruit influencers — we actively help creators grow.

Our team provides strategic support in audience development, content optimization, social media analytics, trend intelligence, and creator branding. We help creators identify what content performs best, how to improve audience retention, and how to scale engagement across multiple platforms.

Creators working with IZISURF may gain access to growth resources, collaboration opportunities, creator partnerships, AI-assisted content workflows, monetization strategies, and entertainment-related campaigns designed to increase visibility and accelerate growth.

We believe that many talented creators struggle not because of creativity, but because they lack access to proper growth infrastructure. IZISURF is designed to solve that problem by combining entertainment culture expertise with modern digital growth systems.

Preferred Qualifications

We are looking for individuals who are highly passionate about Korean entertainment culture and actively follow K-POP, K-Dramas, Korean celebrities, and fandom communities. Strong communication skills, creativity, consistency, and comfort appearing on camera are highly valuable for this role.

Experience with social media content creation is preferred, but we are also open to emerging creators who demonstrate strong potential, personality, and storytelling ability. Familiarity with short-form video platforms, editing tools, and internet culture trends is important.

Candidates who already maintain active social media accounts, fan communities, or entertainment-focused content channels are strongly encouraged to apply. Korean language skills are a plus but are not required.

Ideal Candidate

The ideal candidate is someone who genuinely enjoys talking about Korean entertainment and naturally engages with online communities. You are someone who understands internet culture, stays updated on trends, and enjoys creating content that sparks discussion and engagement.

You are creative, ambitious, and interested in building a long-term digital presence rather than simply posting occasional entertainment updates. You are excited about growing alongside a team that actively supports creator development and digital brand expansion.

Most importantly, you understand fandom culture and can create content that feels authentic, relatable, and engaging to global audiences.

description:

Who We Are

DEXIAN is a global American consulting company focused on technology talent solutions to support and strengthen our clients’ IT teams. We are present in 10 countries, with 45 offices worldwide. For more than 25 years, DEXIAN® has been serving global clients across multiple industries, with the mission of attracting and retaining the world’s top talent.

Today, we are proudly recognized as one of the largest staffing augmentation companies in the United States by Staffing Industry Analysts (SIA). We are also a Minority-Owned Company, and we take pride in our strong commitment to diversity.

In Brazil, we have been operating since 2007 and have successfully partnered with more than 50 clients from different sectors of the economy.


What to Expect From Us

At DEXIAN, every movement is guided by five core values: collaboration, respect, fairness, commitment, and ingenuity. These are not just concepts — they define how we work, build partnerships, and support our teams every day.

If you share these values, this is the right place for you to grow your career.

DEXIAN Brazil strongly encourages diversity, and all opportunities are open to people with disabilities and rehabilitated professionals.


About the Client

This position will support one of our clients, a global company focused in cruises.


Key Responsibilities

  • Own and implement backend services, APIs, and integrations aligned with approved Feature Design Documents
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code following platform standards
  • Proactively refactor code to reduce technical debt within scope
  • Act as the primary gatekeeper for backend code quality through thorough PR reviews
  • Review code for correctness, readability, performance, resource usage, and test coverage
  • Block merges that do not meet quality standards and provide actionable feedback
  • Ensure all implementations align with architectural guidelines and platform standards
  • Develop and maintain unit and integration tests, targeting 80%+ code coverage
  • Contribute to and improve overall test strategies and practices
  • Diagnose and resolve production issues, ensuring root cause resolution
  • Participate in root cause analysis and postmortems
  • Raise technical risks and architectural concerns proactively
  • Collaborate with Tech Lead to ensure alignment on implementation and design direction
  • Partner with mobile engineers on API design and integration contracts
  • Support QA teams with testability improvements and defect resolution
  • Mentor mid-level developers through code reviews and pairing sessions


Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of backend development experience
  • Strong experience with .NET / C# in production environments
  • Solid experience with RESTful API design and microservices architecture
  • Hands-on experience with trunk-based development and continuous integration
  • Strong commitment to code quality and 80%+ test coverage
  • Experience with unit testing frameworks such as xUnit, NUnit, or MSTest
  • Experience with mocking frameworks (NSubstitute preferred, Moq, FakeItEasy)
  • Familiarity with test data generation tools like AutoFixture or Bogus
  • Experience with container-based development and TestContainers
  • Experience using AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot) with governance awareness
  • Advanced English


Additional Information

• 100% Remote position - Brazil

• Long-term / indefinite project

• CLT hiring model + benefits

  • • International team environment

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de dados sênior em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Sua missão:

Construir análises e dashboards que permitam monitorar o funil de vendas e a performance dos canais digitais e de growth, apoiando decisões estratégicas e garantindo que a ConCrédito aproveite ao máximo sua base de clientes.

Você será a principal referência em dados para o time, garantindo qualidade, organização e clareza das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de Comercial, Marketing, Growth e IA


Como será o seu dia a dia:

  • Estruturar e manter dashboards estratégicos e operacionais em Power BI e Metabase.
  • Integrar novas fontes de dados ao data warehouse e às ferramentas de analytics.

  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de modelos de segmentação de clientes (cohort analysis e scoring) para direcionar estratégias comerciais e campanhas.
  • Implementar ou propor soluções criativas utilizando Inteligência Artificial aplicada a dados.

O que buscamos:

  • Experiência sólida com SQL avançado.
  • Experiência com DBT.
  • Vivência com Snowflake.
  • Experiência em Power BI e Metabase para criação de dashboards e análises.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com foco em funil de vendas e KPIs de conversão.
  • Boa comunicação para traduzir dados complexos em informações claras para diferentes áreas do negócio.
  • Perfil proativo.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em operações de vendas digitais de alto volume.
  • Experiência com uso de Inteligência Artificial aplicada a dados.
  • Background em estatística ou modelagem preditiva.
  • Conhecimento em machine learning ou arquiteturas de big data.

title: Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Responsabilidades

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de Planejamento Financeiro Sênior para integrar o time de uma empresa de que presta serviço de BPO Financeiro, consultoria e serviços de CFO Service nos EUA, atuando como peça-chave na gestão financeira estratégica de uma carteira de clientes de diferentes portes, segmentos e níveis de maturidade.

Este profissional será responsável por conduzir, de forma autônoma e estruturada, processos de planejamento, orçamento, análise de desempenho e geração de insights financeiros para múltiplas empresas simultaneamente, atuando como referência técnica e parceiro estratégico dos sócios e gestores dos clientes atendidos.


Planejamento e Orçamento

  • Conduzir o processo de orçamento anual (budget) , revisões orçamentárias (forecast) e planejamento de longo prazo das empresas da carteira.
  • Estruturar e manter modelos financeiros de DRE gerencial, fluxo de caixa projetado, balanço patrimonial e análise de cenários (base, otimista, conservador).

Apoiar a definição de metas, KPIs financeiros e operacionais alinhados às estratégias de cada cliente


Análise de Desempenho e Reporting

  • Elaborar relatórios gerenciais mensais (Management Reports) com análise de variação realizado vs. orçado, drivers de resultado e recomendações de melhoria.
  • Construir e manter dashboards financeiros e painéis de indicadores (KPIs) para acompanhamento contínuo da performance dos clientes.

Realizar análises ad-hoc de rentabilidade por produto, cliente, canal, unidade de negócio ou centro de custo.


Gestão Financeira Multiempresa

  • Atuar como business partner de múltiplos clientes simultaneamente, organizando agenda, prazos, entregas e priorizações de forma independente.
  • Conduzir reuniões de resultado com sócios, diretores e gestores das empresas atendidas, traduzindo números em recomendações claras e acionáveis.

Identificar gargalos, riscos financeiros e oportunidades de melhoria nas operações dos clientes.


Processos, Controle e Melhoria Contínua

  • Padronizar e otimizar processos de planejamento financeiro dentro da carteira atendida, propondo melhorias contínuas.
  • Apoiar a estruturação de plano de contas gerencial , centros de custo e rateios que reflitam corretamente a operação de cada cliente.

Garantir a integridade, consistência e qualidade das informações financeiras geradas, atuando próximo às áreas de contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber e tesouraria.


Qualificações

Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência comprovada em Planejamento Financeiro, FP&A, Controladoria ou Consultoria Financeira.
  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia, Engenharia, Finanças ou áreas correlatas.
  • Pós-graduação, MBA ou certificações em Finanças, Controladoria, FP&A, CFA, CGMA ou equivalentes.
  • Experiência prática com construção de orçamento, forecast, DRE gerencial e fluxo de caixa projetado .
  • Domínio avançado de Excel (modelagem financeira, fórmulas complexas, tabelas dinâmicas, Power Query).
  • Vivência em gestão simultânea de múltiplas empresas, clientes ou unidades de negócio — experiência em BPO Financeiro, consultoria, family office, holding ou auditoria é altamente desejável.
  • Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar de forma autônoma , gerenciando o próprio tempo, prioridades e entregas em ambiente 100% remoto.
  • Inglês nível avançado/ fluente (usará inglês no dia a dia).


Perfil Compartimental (o que esperamos de você)

  • Autonomia e protagonismo: capacidade de conduzir o trabalho de ponta a ponta com mínima supervisão, propondo soluções em vez de apenas reportar problemas.
  • Pensamento analítico e crítico: habilidade de interpretar números, questionar premissas, identificar inconsistências e enxergar a história por trás dos dados.
  • Resolução de problemas: postura proativa para destravar entregas, lidar com ambiguidade e propor caminhos práticos diante de cenários complexos.
  • Organização e disciplina: capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas demandas, prazos e clientes simultaneamente sem perder qualidade ou prazo.
  • Comunicação clara e objetiva: habilidade de traduzir análises técnicas em mensagens compreensíveis para sócios e gestores de diferentes níveis.
  • Postura consultiva: atuação como parceiro estratégico do cliente, e não apenas como executor de relatórios.

Maturidade profissional e ética: discrição no trato com informações sensíveis e confidenciais.


Diferenciais

Conhecimento em ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Looker Studio, Tableau).

Conhecimento em ferramentas de Inteligência Artificial

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Data Analyst em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About us:

Toluna is the global research and insights leader that enables businesses to make smarter, data-driven decisions—faster. For 26 years, we have partnered with the world’s leading brands, delivering transformative impact through our advanced technology platform, comprehensive solution portfolio, expansive global first-party panel, and world-class team of leading research experts. Since 2019, we’ve made significant investments in artificial intelligence to enhance automation, accelerate insight delivery, and unlock deeper understanding at scale. With 40+ offices worldwide, Toluna operates in 70+ countries, redefining the future of insights. Learn


Introduction:

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our global advanced analytics team. In this role, you’ll lead the design and execution of advanced analytical solutions that inform strategic decision-making for our clients. You’ll leverage your deep technical expertise and market research experience to drive innovation, mentor junior analysts, and deliver impactful, data-driven recommendations.


This is an exciting opportunity for a passionate analytics professional who thrives at the intersection of data science, business strategy, and storytelling, with growing expectations around applied AI and intelligent automation.


Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and implementation of advanced analytical frameworks to address complex business challenges across a variety of industries.
  • Partner with internal teams and clients to translate business objectives into analytical solutions, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Design, build, and maintain practical analytics-facing AI-enabled solutions such as analytical agents, automated insights generation, or decision support tools using large language models or similar technologies.
  • Evaluate where AI can responsibly augment analytical work, including data preparation, model development, quality checks, insight synthesis, and delivery, while maintaining methodological rigor.
  • Partner with engineering, analytics, or product teams to operationalize AI-driven analytics in repeatable and scalable ways.
  • Deliver high-impact storytelling and visualization, distilling complex analyses into clear narratives that influence senior stakeholders.
  • Act as a trusted consultant, providing analytic guidance and thought leadership on market research methodologies, data interpretation, and advanced modeling.
  • Mentor and support junior analysts, reviewing outputs, sharing best practices, and fostering a culture of learning and quality.
  • Champion automation, standardization, and innovation, identifying opportunities to optimize workflows and analytical efficiency.
  • Stay current on emerging tools, data science techniques, and market trends to continuously enhance Toluna’s analytics capabilities.


Your profile:

title: Integration Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Integration Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About the Product

Anterior is on a mission to transform healthcare administration, making it seamless and invisible so clinicians can focus on delivering care. We’ve built an AI-powered platform designed by clinicians, for clinicians, to simplify administrative workflows and improve patient outcomes. By combining clinical expertise with cutting-edge technology, we’re revolutionizing healthcare operations with responsible AI.

We’re growing rapidly and are backed by world-class investors including Sequoia, New Enterprise Associates NEA, and Neo along with notable angels including the founders of DeepMind, Google AI, and Inflection AI.

Anterior is improving the experience of healthcare for everyone. We’re working on the cutting edge of using technology to make clinical decision-making frictionless.We’re building exciting tech for huge customers and we trust in the foundations: keep it simple, build strong foundations, and the rest will follow.


The Team

At Anterior, engineers share a strong “sense of product” and solve meaningful problems that simplify healthcare workflows. We collaborate in multidisciplinary teams to deliver secure, scalable, and user-focused solutions guided by best practices and modular design.

We’re building a dedicated deployments team focused on deploying our platform into large US enterprise healthcare environments. This team works closely with customers and our core platform engineers to ensure seamless, reliable integrations into complex payer systems of record.


About You

You have a passion for doing things The Right Way, you believe Less is More, you want to focus on the foundations of system design and architecture (pacelc, consistency guarantees), you care as much about the code you do not write, you’re tired of the hype treadmill and care about the fundamentals. You have battle scars from over-engineered and underperforming slop, and you care about writing code that lasts.

Your depth is in building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect complex systems together reliably. You’ve worked with enterprise customers, dealt with messy data, conflicting sources of truth, and deduplication challenges.

You’ve owned integration design decisions end-to-end — from scoping requirements with a customer to shipping it to production and making sure it holds up. You may be coming from a health tech company, a scale-up doing enterprise deployments, or a platform team that built the connective tissue between systems — what matters is that you’ve navigated real integration complexity and you want ownership over what you build.


About the Role

Members of Technical Staff (Deployments) at Anterior own customer deployment problems end-to-end — from scoping integrations through to production. You’ll be the bridge between our AI platform and the enterprise healthcare systems it plugs into.

A day’s work may include:

  • Designing and building integrations, APIs, and data pipelines that connect our platform to customer systems of record EHRs, claims platforms, care management systems)
  • Working directly with US enterprise healthcare customers to understand their architecture, scope integration requirements, and translate them into technical specs
  • Building and maintaining FHIR, HL7, and custom API integrations with payer and health plan systems
  • Debugging data quality issues — conflicting sources of truth, deduplication, schema mismatches, and edge cases specific to healthcare data
  • Owning UAT testing end-to-end, working with customer IT teams to validate data flows before go-live
  • Building internal tooling and shared integration patterns that make the next deployment faster
  • Contributing to Anterior’s SDKs, developer documentation, and integration playbooks
  • Collaborating closely with the core platform team in New York to ensure integration needs inform platform architecture


Tech

  • Langs: Python / TS
  • Infra: Nix, AWS
  • Healthcare data: FHIR, HL7 (experience preferred but not required — you’ll learn fast if you have strong API and data pipeline fundamentals)


What we’re looking for

  • Strong backend engineering fundamentals — APIs, data pipelines, distributed systems
  • Experience integrating with enterprise systems, ideally in healthcare (payer, EHR, claims) but complex enterprise integrations in other industries count too
  • Comfort working directly with customers and translating ambiguous requirements into clean technical solutions
  • Experience with data quality challenges — deduplication, schema mapping, reconciliation across multiple sources of truth
  • Strong written and spoken communication in English — you’ll be collaborating with teams and customers across time zones
  • Ability to work autonomously from detailed technical specs while flagging blockers and ambiguity early
  • Timezone compatibility with US East Coast ET) working hours


What’s in it for you

This is an opportunity to join a company at its major inflection point, using cutting- edge technology to have a meaningful impact in healthcare. You’ll work with a world-class team, hold significant responsibility, and have the opportunity to learn and grow rapidly.


We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.


As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Network Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Network Engineer to work remotely from anywhere in Brazil for a client in the US.


MUST BE fluent in English.


The Senior Network Engineer provides advanced networking expertise within the Managed Services organization and serves as a subject matter expert and senior escalation point for complex network and firewall issues.

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements.

Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation.
  • Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation.
  • Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation.
  • Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence.
  • Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies.
  • Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment.
  • Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime.
  • Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers.
  • Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks.
  • Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary.
  • Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system.



Requirements

  • 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure.
  • MUST BE fluent in English.
  • Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention.
  • Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs.
  • Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation.
  • Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers.
  • Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis.
  • Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues.


Preferred

  • Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued).
  • Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure.
  • Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments.
  • Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment.
  • Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models.
  • Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects.
  • A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

title: Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior backend Typescript engineer | Fully remote | B2B em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Fullinfo is looking for a Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer to help build the core of its company intelligence platform. You will work on a fully serverless AWS backend in TypeScript, where clean architecture, readable code and long term maintainability matter more than clever engineering theatre.


About Fullinfo

Fullinfo is building a B2B company intelligence platform.

The platform crawls more than 300 million active domains and turns messy web data into clean, structured and searchable company profiles. Sales and marketing teams use Fullinfo to find companies, contacts and insights that are normally hidden across websites, directories, registries and industry sources.


The backend runs fully on AWS, written in TypeScript and built around serverless services like Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS. The frontend is built in Angular. GraphQL is used where it makes sense.


The team is small, international and senior. Around 11 people work across backend, frontend, UX UI, DevOps and machine learning. The culture is direct, calm and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say.


Role description

As Senior Backend TypeScript Engineer, you will work on the backend services and data pipelines that power Fullinfo’s platform.

This is not a management role or an abstract architecture role. You will write code, build services, improve data flows and make sure the backend stays simple, scalable and maintainable.

You will work closely with the CTO, principal engineer and other backend engineers. There is ownership, but not much hand holding. The direction is clear. The expectation is that you can think for yourself and build things properly.


Your work includes:

• Writing backend logic in TypeScript on AWS Lambda

• Building services across the data pipeline

• Working with S3, DynamoDB, SQS and other AWS services

• Improving performance and cost efficiency

• Keeping the architecture clean and understandable

• Writing code that is easy to read, test and change

• Collaborating with frontend engineers working in Angular

• Contributing to technical decisions as the product grows


Fullinfo values clarity over cleverness and structure over shortcuts.


Requirements

You bring:

• 5 plus years of backend engineering experience

• Strong TypeScript experience

• Real experience with AWS serverless services

• Hands on experience with Lambda, S3, DynamoDB and SQS

• A strong instinct for clean architecture and maintainability

• Comfort working in a small remote team with minimal process

• Business level English

• You are based within 3 hours of Central European Time or are located in LATAM


Conditions

• 12 month B2B contract

• Fully remote work

• Long term project with unlimited extensions


The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team.


Interested?

Apply trough the link.

Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Confira esta oportunidade para Controlling - Strategic Initiatives Analyst - Remote Work em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Controlling - Strategic Initiatives Analyst position involves supporting decision-making through data-driven insights. This role requires analyzing business data, identifying improvement opportunities, and proposing changes to core processes while working closely with leadership and multiple business areas to ensure data consistency, accuracy, and alignment across different departments.


Key responsibilities


- Analyzing business and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.

- Proposing changes and optimizations to key business processes based on data analysis.

- Developing proactive analyses and responding to data requests from the Board.

- Building reports and dashboards to support strategic and operational decision-making.

- Collaborating with Finance, Sales, Client Services, IT, HR, Marketing, Talent Acquisition, and R&D teams.

- Ensuring data consistency, accuracy, and alignment across different business areas.


Requirements


- Analytical Experience: Experience in business analysis, controlling, data analysis, or a related role.

- Analytical Skills: Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with cross-functional business teams.

- Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools.

- Communication Skills: Strong communication skills to present insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: ABAP Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para ABAP Developer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABAP Developer


About Pyxus


We are a global company with more than 150 years of history, committed to creating a better-growing world. Our mission is to produce high-quality products and ingredients through sustainable practices, ensuring social, environmental, and production traceability, while promoting the well-being of farmers and the communities we serve.

As part of the Pyxus group, Alliance One Brasil shares this vision, and we believe in a future where people are inspired to achieve excellence, communities are strengthened by trust and innovation, and value is created through a commitment to serve. Our culture is built on resilience, accountability, encouragement, and transparency, and we value each team member for their experience, knowledge, and passion.

Join Pyxus and help us grow a better world together!


Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ABAP programs within SAP ECC
  • Deliver enhancements, reports, interfaces, forms, and workflows
  • Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization
  • Collaborate with functional teams to translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Contribute to testing, documentation, and transport management
  • Assist in planning and executing system upgrades, patches and kernel updates across the SAP landscape.
  • Support release management, including transport movements and documentation.
  • Assist in planning and executing SAP system refreshes & copies.
  • Assist in Annual activities SAP DR Test & Archive technical objects data.
  • Apply SAP Notes based on technical/functional requirements.


Qualifications/Requirements

  • Fluent English
  • Strong experience in ABAP development on SAP ECC.
  • Experience with interfaces (IDocs, BAPIs, RFCs)
  • Good understanding of SAP MM/PTP/FI/SD Modules
  • Experience in debugging and performance tuning
  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and with global teams.
  • Hands on with RF Development a plus.
  • Understanding of modern cloud architectures and the SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP)
  • Experience migrating to or developing within SAP S/4HANA a Plus.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams

Mobile Phone Plan

title: Delivery Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Delivery Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Descrição da vaga


Buscamos um(a) Delivery Manager para atuar como elo estratégico entre a execução técnica e o cliente, garantindo que o que foi prometido seja entregue com excelência, previsibilidade e transparência.


Essa pessoa será responsável pela gestão de duas plataformas estratégicas de Agentic AI e Machine Learning , operando em um dos contextos tecnológicos mais exigentes do mercado financeiro brasileiro. O desafio envolve coordenação de múltiplas frentes técnicas, relacionamento com stakeholders de diferentes níveis e garantia de governança, qualidade e evolução contínua dos processos de delivery.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como ponto focal de entrega junto ao cliente , representando a empresa com autoridade técnica e postura executiva nas frentes de Agentic AI e Machine Learning
  • Gerenciar o ciclo completo de delivery dos projetos: planejamento, acompanhamento, controle de escopo, gestão de riscos e comunicação de status
  • Conduzir cerimônias de alinhamento com stakeholders do cliente, incluindo squads técnicos, lideranças de produto e tecnologia
  • Identificar e endereçar proativamente riscos, desvios de prazo, escopo ou qualidade , evitando escalações e impactos ao negócio
  • Garantir visibilidade executiva do andamento das frentes por meio de relatórios, dashboards e rituais de governança
  • Atuar como facilitador(a) entre os times técnicos internos e as áreas do cliente, removendo impedimentos e acelerando a tomada de decisão
  • Colaborar diretamente com a Head de Operações na priorização de demandas, alocação de pessoas e evolução do time
  • Contribuir para a evolução dos processos de delivery da prática de AI & Analytics, documentando aprendizados, padrões e boas práticas


Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência sólida como Delivery Manager, Engagement Manager ou Project Manager em ambientes tecnológicos complexos
  • Vivência em projetos de dados, Machine Learning, AI, plataformas ou cloud
  • Experiência em gestão de múltiplos stakeholders, incluindo times técnicos e lideranças executivas
  • Conhecimento prático em gestão de riscos, escopo, prazos e governança
  • Capacidade de leitura estratégica do contexto do cliente e tradução de necessidades de negócio em planos de entrega
  • Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis e rituais de acompanhamento (Scrum, Kanban, OKRs, etc.)
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e orientada a diferentes públicos


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência prévia em instituições financeiras ou ambientes regulados
  • Conhecimento em plataformas de dados, MLOps ou arquitetura cloud
  • Atuação anterior em consultorias ou empresas de tecnologia


Habilidades comportamentais

  • Forte senso de responsabilidade e ownership
  • Comunicação executiva, clara e assertiva
  • Capacidade de antecipar problemas e agir de forma preventiva
  • Habilidade de negociação e gestão de expectativas
  • Organização, disciplina e foco em resultados
  • Facilidade para transitar entre o técnico e o estratégico
  • Postura colaborativa e orientada à construção de relações de confiança



Sobre a empresa


Become a Compasser, be part of AI/R.

Compass UOL is a global firm and part of the AI Revolution Company, together transforming organizations using Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and other of today’s most advanced technologies.

We equip our team with proprietary and external AI-driven tools to design and build digital-native platforms, integrating cutting-edge technologies and enabling companies to innovate, transform their businesses, and drive success in their markets.

To achieve this, we attract and develop the best talent, creating opportunities that enhance people’s lives and highlight the positive impact of disruptive technologies.

We empower borderless talent and promote knowledge and opportunities in the latest market trends, driving significant personal and professional growth.

title: Editor de Vídeos
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Editor de Vídeos em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Vaga: Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior — 100% Remoto | CLT + Plano de Saúde + Bônus


LEIA ATÉ O FINAL COM ATENÇÃO - NÃO ADIANTA SÓ CLICAR EM SE CANDIDATAR AQUI NO LINKEDIN


Em menos de 2 anos, possivelmente, já somos a maior clínica de fisioterapia pélvica particular do Brasil e nosso ritmo de crescimento é acelerado e cada vez mais rápido.


Conteúdo é um dos motores desse crescimento. Cada corte que sai da nossa edição educa pacientes, quebra tabus sobre disfunções íntimas e mostra que existe tratamento sério para problemas que a maioria dos lugares trata errado.


Agora estamos abrindo vaga para um(a) Editor(a) de Vídeo Júnior que queira entrar nesse time, aprender rápido e crescer junto.


O pacote


• Salário fixo: R$ 1.830


• Ajuda de custo: R$ 300


• Bônus mensal de até R$ 300 (por desempenho e comportamento)


• Plano de saúde


• Regime CLT, 100% remoto


Total possível inicial: até R$ 2.430/mês + plano de saúde.


Cargo Júnior. Mas não é uma vaga para quem quer ficar Júnior. Quem entrega, evolui rápido para Pleno — esse é o nosso jeito de operar em todos os cargos.


A vaga em uma frase


Assistir vídeos longos da PelvClinic, achar os melhores trechos e transformar em cortes curtos que prendem atenção no Reels, TikTok e Shorts.


A edição técnica importa. Mas escolher o corte certo importa mais. Saber identificar qual trecho começa forte, qual fala gera curiosidade, qual explicação tem valor — esse é o olhar que faz a diferença entre um editor comum e um editor que move o ponteiro.


É isso que vamos te ensinar e cobrar.


Como você vai trabalhar


Você será liderado(a) pela Emilly, nossa Social Media, que vai te orientar no dia a dia: demanda, feedback, padrão de qualidade, prioridades.


Trabalho remoto exige maturidade. Você precisa ter:


• Computador próprio com capacidade real para edição


• Boa internet


• Organização para entregar sem ser lembrado


• Disponibilidade para alinhamentos com a Emilly


Se você precisa de cobrança constante para produzir, essa vaga não é pra você.


O que estamos buscando


Três coisas — em ordem de importância:


1. Olho para conteúdo. Capacidade de assistir uma hora de vídeo e identificar os 30 segundos que prendem atenção sozinhos.


2. Constância. Entregar bem hoje, amanhã e na semana que vem. Não picos seguidos de sumiço.


3. Vontade real de crescer. Pessoa que estuda referência por conta própria, aceita feedback sem peso, aplica e volta melhor.


>>>Teste prático (Passo 1)<<<


Vídeo de explicação do teste:


A sua pontuação no teste terá base na qualidade e quantidade de bons cortes e conteúdos que conseguir extrair de cada vídeo longo:


• Vídeos curtos de alcance em formato 16:9 (geralmente de 20 segundos até 2 minutos — topo de funil)


• Vídeos médios de 2 a 7 minutos formato 16:9, mais completos e explicados, para gerar mais profundidade de relacionamento (meio e fundo de funil)


• Carrosséis, tanto dos vídeos longos base, quanto dos vídeos menores


FAQ: tem número de vídeos que vocês imaginam?


O teste é para ver a sua capacidade de extrair o maior número de bons conteúdos e ideias possível de cada vídeo longo (vídeos menores e posts/carrosséis).


P.S. Os vídeos já foram editados por nós, e essa será a régua para classificação.


Vídeos longos base (extrair vídeos curtos e carrosséis):


Vídeo 1:


Vídeo 2:


Quanto maior o número e a qualidade dos conteúdos, mais alta sua pontuação.


Penalização por conteúdos ruins ou fracos. Sem encher linguiça — o que conta é volume de conteúdos bons.


Critérios de avaliação:


• Seleção de tema e clareza da ideia


• Título / Headline escrito


• Gancho falado — força nos 0–3s e 0–7s, curiosidade e interesse sem clickbait


• Entrega de conteúdo — satisfação depois de consumir


• Comunicação da marca — ética, acolhimento, evidência, linguagem simples


• Velocidade e capricho — quanto mais rápido melhor, arquivos nomeados, zero ruído


Referências de vídeos curtos:










>>>Como se candidatar (por e-mail)<<<


Envie o teste feito para:


•


•


Assunto: Vaga Editor de Vídeo Júnior — (Seu Nome)


Corpo: ENVIE o Link (pasta no drive) dos conteúdos que você editou + currículo


Para quem essa vaga não é


• Quem quer trabalho remoto pra ficar tranquilo


• Quem precisa de cobrança constante pra entregar


• Quem reage a feedback como ataque


• Quem quer fazer o mínimo e receber o suficiente


Para quem essa vaga é


• Quem está começando mas quer crescer rápido


• Quem topa trabalhar duro para se provar


• Quem quer entrar numa empresa que está construindo algo grande e ter a chance de crescer junto

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Essa posição é estratégica para evoluirmos a alocação como produto: vai do diagnóstico e modelagem até deploy, monitoramento, IA aplicada à decisão e mensuração de impacto, atuando em parceria com Produto, Engenharia/MLE, Planning, Logística e Negócio.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar o desenvolvimento, evolução e operacionalização de modelos avançados de machine learning para problemas de negócio de alta complexidade.
  • Atuar em desafios de modelagem preditiva, incluindo previsão de demanda, identificação de padrões comportamentais, otimização e apoio à tomada de decisão.
  • Estruturar abordagens robustas de experimentação, validação e monitoramento de modelos, garantindo qualidade, confiabilidade e evolução contínua das soluções.
  • Construir pipelines analíticos escaláveis para preparação, transformação e exploração de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com times multidisciplinares para transformar problemas ambíguos em soluções analíticas aplicáveis e escaláveis.
  • Liderar discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura analítica, boas práticas de modelagem e evolução da disciplina de ciência de dados.
  • Explorar e desenvolver soluções baseadas em IA aplicada, incluindo agentes inteligentes, automação de processos analíticos e uso de modelos generativos quando fizer sentido para o problema.
  • Apoiar a operacionalização de soluções analíticas em produção, incluindo monitoramento, performance e governança.
  • Comunicar recomendações, aprendizados e trade-offs técnicos de forma clara para stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, apoiando o desenvolvimento de outros cientistas por meio de mentorias, revisões técnicas e disseminação de conhecimento.


Requisitos Necessários

  • Experiência comprovada de 6 a 8 anos em projetos de ciência de dados.
  • Forte domínio de estatística, machine learning e experimentação.
  • Experiência sólida em modelagem preditiva aplicada a problemas complexos de negócio, incluindo previsão de demanda e séries temporais, com domínio de algoritmos de machine learning supervisionado como XGBoost, LightGBM e CatBoost.
  • Proficiência em Python e SQL para análise, modelagem e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud e ecossistemas analíticos escaláveis (BigQuery, Airflow ou similares).
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio pouco estruturados em soluções analíticas robustas.
  • Experiência com implantação, monitoramento e evolução de modelos em produção.
  • Forte capacidade analítica, pensamento crítico e excelente comunicação com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.
  • Noções de MLOps.
  • Sólida vivência em versionamento de código (Git), com prática de code review, padrões de branches e integração contínua.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com IA generativa, LLMs e desenvolvimento de agentes.
  • Vivência com frameworks como LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI ou similares.
  • Experiência em varejo.
  • Conhecimento em técnicas de visualização de dados e storytelling.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de business intelligence, como Power BI.

title: Engenheiro IA
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Engenheiro IA em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job Description

A Genesis Consulting tem oportunidade para Engenheiros de IA experientes com verdadeira paixão por crescimento profissional e entrega de valor através da tecnologia. Nossos clientes são alguns dos principais líderes mundiais em diferentes indústrias e o candidato fará parte de projetos desafiadores para construir e apoiar soluções técnicas para suas necessidades.


Duties and Responsibilities:

• Pesquisar, desenvolver e implementar metodologias avançadas de Large Language Models (LLMs) para criação de produtos de dados baseados em IA generativa.

• Desenvolver e aprimorar técnicas de Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), combinando embeddings e bancos de vetores para melhorar precisão e relevância das respostas dos modelos.

• Aplicar técnicas de segurança e governança para IA generativa, mitigando alucinações, viés e riscos éticos no uso de LLMs.

• Automatizar e monitorar o desempenho de modelos generativos em produção, utilizando frameworks de MLOps e ferramentas de observabilidade de IA.

• Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de engenharia, produto e negócio para transformar desafios empresariais em soluções escaláveis baseadas em IA generativa.


Minimum Qualifications/Experience:

• Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e aplicação de LLMs e fluxos agênticos.

• Forte domínio de Python, frameworks como LangGraph, PydanticAI, LlamaIndex, e ferramentas de MLOps para produção de modelos generativos.

• Proficiência em Vector Databases (FAISS, ChromaDB, Weaviate, Milvus, Pinecone) e pipelines de dados escaláveis.

• Conhecimento avançado em Machine Learning, Deep Learning e Fine-Tuning de modelos fundacionais.

• Experiência com deploy e monitoramento de modelos em produção, incluindo técnicas de inferência eficiente, caching e otimização.

• Familiaridade com conceitos de governança, segurança e alinhamento de modelos generativos.


Minimum Education:

  • Ensino superior completo.
  • Inglês Fluente

title: Lab Systems Architect
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Lab Systems Architect em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

ABOUT US

Syniti, part of Capgemini is the enterprise data partner, empowering anyone who relies on data to make business-critical decisions by delivering data they can trust through a unique combination of intelligent software and experts who deeply understand the role of data in enterprise growth. At Syniti, we tackle the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. As the industry’s only pure-play data company, we combine our Data First strategy, intelligent software and team of 100% data-focused experts to turn complex data initiatives into quantifiable business success.



Trusted by the Fortune 2000, Syniti helps leading businesses reconfigure the role of enterprise data from afterthought to foundational first step; enabling them to unlock valuable insights that ignite growth, reduce risk, and expand their competitive advantage. We’ve enabled more than 5,000 successful projects and we’re a trusted partner for global enterprises and organizations throughout their data journeys.



Syniti’s Data First philosophy and enterprise data management platform supports data migration, data quality, data replication, data matching, master data management, analytics, data governance, and data strategy in a single, unified solution.



THE ROLE

The Lab Systems Architect plays a critical role in the success of Syniti’s Education Services department by designing, implementing, and maintaining technical lab environments that support both eLearning and instructor-led training. This role ensures the seamless operation of lab systems, supports integration with learning platforms, and collaborates cross-functionally to enhance system workflows and user experience. The ideal candidate is a technically skilled, detail-oriented problem solver with a passion for enabling learning through robust infrastructure.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

Learning Lab Architecture & Management

  • Provide technical oversight for the design, testing, provisioning, and implementation of Learning Lab environments.
  • Manage and maintain lab snapshots, resolving configuration defects as they arise.
  • Optimize lab usage policies in collaboration with Education Coordinators and Leadership.
  • Monitor VM usage reports and metrics, ensuring alignment with budget and demand.
  • Support LMS system integrations as required.
  • Serve as the primary escalation point for lab-related issues and liaise with solution providers to resolve complex problems across all learning lab platforms.


System Administration & Support

  • Allocate and reset user training accounts.
  • Stay current with new feature releases across all education platforms.
  • Provide on-call support for lab systems used in global training programs, including availability during evenings and weekends as needed.
  • Regularly review help desk tickets to identify recurring issues, usage patterns, and knowledge gaps. Recommend targeted training, updated documentation, or additional support resources to proactively address common challenges and improve user experience.
  • Train internal and partner instructors on lab systems.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Management

  • Collaborate with Training Operations, Delivery Management, IT, and Application teams to improve workflows, system functionality, and user experience.
  • Manage stakeholder expectations and requirements related to lab systems and processes.
  • Identify and resolve cross-functional issues to ensure company-wide alignment on lab system needs.


Reporting & Documentation

  • Document system configurations, best practices, and technical procedures.
  • Own and maintain the Education Services Revenue Report, providing monthly updates to Finance.
  • Support the creation and maintenance of Education Services forms, lists, automations, and integrations, as required.



WHAT IT TAKES

  • Proficiency in SQL and at least one of the following databases: Oracle, MS SQL Server, IBM DB2, or MySQL.
  • Experience managing hypervisor solutions and SaaS platform architecture.
  • Knowledge of Microsoft Forms, Power Automate, Power BI, and SharePoint.
  • Experience with Windows Server and Azure Active Directory.
  • Understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).
  • Strong technical writing and documentation skills.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Knowledge of GraphQL queries and mutations (preferred).
  • Self-starter with a proactive approach to problem-solving.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Passion for education technology and continuous improvement.



Be fully aligned to our core values:


  • Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
  • Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
  • Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
  • Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.



WHAT WE OFFER

  • Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
  • Growth . We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
  • Support . We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
  • Curiosity and genuine interest in you . We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
  • Recognition . We are the sum of individual achievements and we always take the time to celebrate them.
  • An open organisation . Titles don’t define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone’s work is seen and valued.



Our Commitment to Inclusion


At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.

We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.
